# Pro Kabaddi Final Highlights: #DabangDelhiKC vs #PuneriPaltan | October 31 | PKL Season 12
## Pro Kabaddi
1080000 subscribers

Posted: 1 Nov 2025
The PKL Season 12 Grand Finale was a match for the ages. It started with Delhi on the front foot, with the Paltan narrowing the margin with every raid. Aditya Shinde’s raiding heroics earned him a Super 10 and kept Paltan in the game for the majority of the match. Abinesh and Gaurav were a dream duo at the back, giving viewers breathtaking super tackles. However, it was Delhi’s game to lose, as the match ended with a scoreline of 31–28. Neeraj and Ajinkya’s tight raids kept the Dabangs in the lead for most of the game, while the defence worked in pairs to put pressure on the raiders in orange.
